Gun attack sheet: sunk one (1) SMC (EC) (large four-masted sailing vessel) - 600 tons; fast pass at 500 yards with two 40 MM, one 20 MM, two .50 cal., then destroyed with the 5 inch at point blank range as day was breaking. Ammunition 5in. 17, 40 MM 68, 20 MM 180, .50 cal. 390 rds. Narrative (p18): 0337 Ship Contact No. 5; two of the vessel's crew abandoned ship

Attack sheet: a submarine trap of two Whalekillers acting the part of tug and tow; radar contact 9550 yards. Narrative (p19-p20): 2137 Ship Contact No. 6; 2301 fired two torpedoes from bow tubes on a 90 starboard track, range about 600 yards; the tug turned to ram and missed our stern by about 100 yards; one torpedo from the stern nest down the throat at 580 yards; all missed; about two miles off KAIYO TO

Gun attack sheet: sunk 2 XPC (EC) (whalekiller type - 300 tons each) - 600 tons; night action with all guns; both whalekillers returned fire with what looked like 37 MMs; the trailer attempted to ram; the 20 MM set his pilot house on fire at about 75 yards and a 5 inch hit blew it away; both vessels seen to sink. Ammunition 5in. 12, 40 MM 88, 20 MM 300, .50 cal. 1040 rds. Narrative p20-p21

Gun attack sheet: time 1349 to 1606(I); sunk (or destroyed) 7 MIS (EC) (identical two-masted schooners) - 700 tons; four sank, three floated barely awash; ranges 150 to 300 yards; warning shots fired in each case to allow crews to abandon ship; all targets bore Japanese colors; two schooners returned fire with pistols or rifles. Ammunition 5in. 27, 40 MM 294, 20 MM 180, .50 cal. 720 rds.

Narrative (p24): 0032 fired tubes 6 5 4 3, gyro angles about 5 right, 95 starboard track, runs 600 yards; three hits; target disappeared from the radar scope three minutes after being hit

Attack sheet: target was one of two escorts for the transport sunk in Torpedo Attack No. 4; not sighted, heavy fog; radar contact 10,000 yards; torpedoes missed. Narrative (p24): 0140 fired tubes 4 3 2 1, gyro angles 10 left, track angles 70 starboard, runs 1250 yards; all missed
